name: Suriname

fees.name: Entry Fee (formerly E-Tourist Card)
fees.applies: eligible nationalities (list of ~52 countries published on official portal, e.g. many EU states, Bolivia, etc.)
fees.notes: Plus a non-refundable online processing/service fee of USD 14 (or USD 18 per the fee-schedule page, which appears to be the standardized service fee for all application types). Payable in USD or EUR (EUR 35 for the entry fee itself).

fees.name: Entry Fee (single entry, general)
fees.applies: nationalities requiring a full visa/entry fee (not on the 52-country tourist-card list)
fees.notes: Also payable as EUR 50. Plus service fee (see vfs.service_fee).

fees.name: Multiple Entry Fee (5 Entries)
fees.notes: Also payable as EUR 75. Plus service fee.

fees.name: Business Visa - 3 months validity
fees.notes: Also payable as EUR 85. Plus service fee.

fees.name: Business Visa - 5 years validity
fees.applies: general rate (USA passport holders pay USD 160 instead, see reciprocity_variations)
fees.notes: Also payable as EUR 305. Plus service fee.

fees.name: Tourist Visa - 3 months
fees.applies: nationalities requiring a traditional tourist visa (not eligible for Entry Fee/tourist card)
fees.notes: Also payable as EUR 50. Multiple entry, max stay 90 days. Plus service fee.

fees.name: Tourist Visa - 1 Year
fees.applies: nationalities requiring a traditional tourist visa
fees.notes: Also payable as EUR 175. Multiple entry, max stay 90 days. Plus service fee.

fees.name: Transit Visa
fees.notes: Also payable as EUR 10. Single entry. Plus service fee.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival (diplomatic/service/official/Interpol passport holders only)
fees.applies: diplomatic, service, or official passport holders, or Interpol passport/ID holders with an official invitation traveling on duty
fees.notes: Standard tourist visa-on-arrival was discontinued in October 2019; only this narrow diplomatic/official category remains eligible at the airport. No official fee amount was found published by an official source, so amount is left null.

reciprocity_variations.note: 5-year multiple-entry Business Visa for USA passport holders costs USD 160 versus the general rate of USD 360, per the official VFS Global Suriname e-Visa fee schedule.

vfs.note: VFS Global is the official government-authorized partner operating Suriname's e-Visa/Entry Fee portal. A non-refundable online processing/service fee applies to all application types: the Entry Fee (tourist card) page states USD 14 (EUR equivalent not separately listed), while the general fee-schedule page lists a flat service fee of USD 18 or EUR 17 for all application types. This is charged in addition to the visa/entry fee itself.

free_visa_notes: Suriname is not visa-free for most nationalities; most travelers require either an Entry Fee (tourist card, for ~52 eligible nationalities) or a full e-Visa/tourist visa. Nationals of some countries (e.g., other CARICOM/regional states) may be visa-exempt per Suriname's visa policy, but no official fee-schedule source enumerating a visa-free list was captured in this research; consult the official portal's nationality list for exemptions.
